purpose: Machine-checkable declarations for art review. This contract validates review records and evidence bindings; it does not inspect pixels.

source_precedence.rule: Original pencil portraits control facial structure, asymmetry, brows, eyes, noses, curls and human variation.
Use finish, material, mark-making and cinematic mood; do not copy faces, cover layouts or typography indiscriminately.
Deep navy and steel shadows, charcoal and copper-amber light without dull monochrome or pigment shifts.
Canonical build, hair, age, expression, costume, props and historical variants; later explicit author corrections supersede older entries.

global_rules.visual_language: Complete cinematic hand-inked 2D graphic-novel animation derived from the author's drawings; not generic anime, 3D, glossy vector art or unfinished graphite.
global_rules.line: Confident irregular variable-width ink, controlled broken edges and intentional hatching/crosshatching with clean readable silhouettes.
global_rules.faces: Individualized angular organic construction, grounded expressive eyes, uneven bold brows, specific noses and human asymmetry; anime influence is limited to acting and polish.
global_rules.color: Full rich color with painterly wash, paper tooth, two or three cel planes and a navy/steel versus amber split while preserving skin pigment.
global_rules.text: No generated words, slogans, labels, meaningless graffiti, watermarks or speech-bubble dialogue. Only explicitly requested editorial typography is allowed, and accurate story signage is composited in post.
global_rules.animation: Substantial acting uses registered replacement drawings. Camera motion, holds, mesh warps, optical-flow morphs and sliding cutouts do not substitute for character or environmental action.
global_rules.geometry: Faces, skulls, hands, grips, props, hulls and contact points remain stable; rigid objects stay rigid and effects remain on independent layers.
global_rules.crop: Requested subjects, hands, shoes and action silhouettes remain intentionally framed; accidental clipping fails.
global_rules.layers: Characters, rigid props, effects, foregrounds and backgrounds remain independently usable whenever the requested mode requires production layers.

criteria.source_precedence: Review identifies authoritative sources in precedence order and records any current author correction.
criteria.identity: Named characters match approved facial landmarks, build, hair, age, costume, accessories and historical variant.
criteria.style: Frame retains the author's handmade ink character, controlled crosshatching, clean silhouette and non-generic facial construction.
criteria.grade: Navy, steel, charcoal and amber lighting is scene-appropriate, luminous and pigment-safe rather than dull or globally tinted.
criteria.text: No unauthorized, malformed or generated text is present; any allowed typography is exact and explicitly requested.
criteria.anatomy_geometry: Anatomy, face volume, digits, rigid props, scale and contact geometry are stable and intentional.
criteria.crop: Composition contains every required body part, object and action path without accidental crop or atlas-panel clipping.
criteria.layers: The deliverable has the requested clean plate, alpha, registration, matte and separable layer structure.
criteria.action: Pose, weight, timing, arcs, secondary motion and environmental response cover the scripted action; no static-pan or warp substitution.
criteria.setting: Architecture, landscape, materials and wear are specific to the scripted Bronx, Santo Domingo or Taíno context rather than stock scenery.
criteria.typography: Editorial type appears only when directly requested, is accurate, and stays out of production scene art.
criteria.single_asset: Deliverable is the requested single character, plate or frame rather than an unsolicited collage or contact sheet.

constraints: Exactly one named character unless a multi-view sheet is explicitly requested.
Use transparent or neutral dark-slate background.
Keep requested full body, hands and shoes inside frame.
No title, slogans, floating notes, random crowns or collage tiles.
No inserted character unless explicitly requested.
Provide camera-ready depth layers or a documented clean plate.
No inexplicable graffiti, motivational text or stock sci-fi neon.
Include only storyboard-required characters, poses, props and setting.
Speech bubbles remain blank only when the comic script explicitly requests bubbles.
Dialogue and exact signage are composited in post.
A camera move or warped painting never counts as completed acting.
Issue headings, captions and typography are allowed only when directly requested.
Mood exploration does not establish character identity canon without author approval.
Editorial layout rules do not transfer to character assets, plates or story frames.

promotion.rule: Technical approval and author approval are separate gates. Only an exact digest approved by Luis M. Minier may become canonical. A rejected artifact must be revised into a new asset/version and reviewed from the start.
